name: Cinolazepam
summary: A benzodiazepine derivative drug with anxiolytic effects but mainly hypnotic effects. It is extremely effective as a sleep aid but has mild euphoria compared to other benzodiazepines.
advisory: Caution: Do not mix with any CNS depressants. The combination can prove to be fatal and also increases likelihood of blacking out.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: It possesses anxiolytic, anticonvulsant, sedative and skeletal muscle relaxant properties.

uses.text: Cinolazepam (marketed under the brand name Gerodorm) is a drug which is a benzodiazepine derivative. Due to its strong sedative properties, it is primarily used as a hypnotic. It was patented in 1978 and came into medical use in 1992.

summaryZh: 西諾西泮（英語：Cinolazepam），以商品名Gerodorm銷售，是一種苯二氮䓬類衍生藥物。它具有抗焦慮、抗痙攣、鎮靜和骨骼肌鬆弛作用。由於其強大的鎮靜作用，它主要用作催眠藥。
summaryZhHans: 西诺西泮（英语：Cinolazepam），以商品名Gerodorm销售，是一种苯二氮䓬类衍生药物。它具有抗焦虑、抗惊厥、镇静和骨骼肌松弛作用。由于其强大的镇静作用，它主要用作催眠药。
